buttons.q: Is BUTTONS a singular noun or a plural noun?
buttons.hint: The answer is "plural noun". Buttons means more than one button, so it is a plural noun.

buttons.q: What part of speech is BUTTONS in: 'My coat has four shiny buttons.'?
buttons.hint: The answer is "plural noun". Here buttons names more than one thing on the coat.

buttons.q: Which sentence uses BUTTONS as a plural noun?
options: Dad buttons his coat before he goes out.
Grandma sewed two red buttons on my shirt.
Sam quickly buttons up his sweater.
buttons.hint: The answer is "Grandma sewed two red buttons on my shirt.". In that sentence, buttons names the things Grandma sewed, not an action.

buttons.q: Which word is a plural noun: buttons, puffy, invite?
buttons.hint: The answer is "buttons". Buttons names more than one thing; puffy describes and invite is an action.

buttons.q: In 'Lily lost three buttons at recess,' what does the word BUTTONS do?
buttons.hint: The answer is "names more than one thing". A plural noun names more than one person, place, or thing.

buttons.q: What does BUTTONS mean?
options: small round things you push through holes to close clothes
small bugs that hop in the grass
buttons.hint: The answer is "small round things you push through holes to close clothes". Buttons go through little holes to keep your shirt or coat closed.

buttons.q: Read: 'Ben's shirt kept flapping open because two buttons were missing.' What are buttons here?
options: stripes of color on a shirt
things that hold the shirt closed
buttons.hint: The answer is "things that hold the shirt closed". Without the buttons, the shirt could not stay closed.

buttons.q: Where would you most likely find buttons?
buttons.hint: The answer is "on a coat". Coats often have buttons to keep them closed.

buttons.q: Which of these things usually has buttons?
buttons.hint: The answer is "a winter coat". A winter coat is clothing, and buttons close clothes.

buttons.q: Which of these does the same job as buttons on a jacket?
buttons.hint: The answer is "a zipper". A zipper also closes a jacket, just like buttons.

buttons.q: What would you do with buttons?
options: pour them into a glass to drink
push them through holes to close your shirt
buttons.hint: The answer is "push them through holes to close your shirt". Buttons are pushed through holes to close clothes.

buttons.q: Fill in the blank: 'I can't close my sweater because the ____ are too big for the holes.'
buttons.hint: The answer is "buttons". Buttons go through holes to close a sweater.

buttons.q: Which sentence uses BUTTONS correctly?
options: We swam in the buttons at the beach.
Mom sewed the loose buttons back onto my coat.
The buttons sang a song in the tree.
buttons.hint: The answer is "Mom sewed the loose buttons back onto my coat.". Buttons are sewn onto clothes like coats.

buttons.q: Which word fits: Jada's doll has a tiny coat with little round ____ on the front.
buttons.hint: The answer is "buttons". Little round things on the front of a coat are buttons.

buttons.q: Fill in the blank: 'Grandpa keeps extra ____ in a tin so he can fix shirts.'
buttons.hint: The answer is "buttons". You fix a shirt by sewing on new buttons.

buttons.q: Which word fits: A clown's big jacket had giant polka-dot ____ to keep it closed.
buttons.hint: The answer is "buttons". Buttons keep a jacket closed.

buttons.q: Which is the correct spelling?
buttons.hint: The answer is "buttons". Buttons has double t and ends with -ons.

buttons.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'My shirt has six ____.'
buttons.hint: The answer is "buttons". Buttons is spelled b-u-t-t-o-n-s.

buttons.q: Fill the missing letters: b_tt_ns
buttons.hint: The answer is "u, o". Put in u and o to spell b-u-t-t-o-n-s.

buttons.q: Which of these words is spelled correctly?
buttons.hint: The answer is "buttons". The plural ending here is -s, and the middle vowel is o.

cuddle.q: What part of speech is CUDDLE in: 'I like to cuddle my puppy at bedtime.'?
cuddle.hint: The answer is "verb". Cuddle is the action I do with my puppy.

cuddle.q: Which sentence uses CUDDLE as a verb?
options: The kids cuddle the baby goats at the farm.
The baby gave me a big cuddle.
We had a long cuddle on the couch.
cuddle.hint: The answer is "The kids cuddle the baby goats at the farm.". In that sentence, cuddle is the action the kids do.

cuddle.q: A verb is an action word. Which kind of word is CUDDLE in: 'Kittens cuddle together to stay warm.'?
cuddle.hint: The answer is "verb". Cuddle tells what the kittens do.

cuddle.q: Which word is a verb: cuddle, kelp, puffy?
cuddle.hint: The answer is "cuddle". Cuddle is an action; kelp is a thing and puffy describes.

cuddle.q: In 'Please cuddle your little brother when he is sad,' what does CUDDLE do?
cuddle.hint: The answer is "shows an action". A verb shows an action, like cuddling someone.

cuddle.q: What does CUDDLE mean?
options: to hold someone close and hug them
cuddle.hint: The answer is "to hold someone close and hug them". When you cuddle, you hold someone close in a hug.

cuddle.q: Read: 'When the storm was loud, Mia cuddled her teddy bear.' What did Mia do?
cuddle.hint: The answer is "held it close". Mia hugged her bear close to feel safe.

cuddle.q: Which word means almost the same as CUDDLE?
cuddle.hint: The answer is "snuggle". To snuggle is to hold someone close, just like cuddle.

cuddle.q: Which is the opposite of CUDDLE?
cuddle.hint: The answer is "push away". Pushing someone away is the opposite of holding them close.

cuddle.q: Which of these shows someone cuddling?
options: A dad holds his sleepy baby close.
A boy kicks a ball across the field.
A girl writes her name on a test.
cuddle.hint: The answer is "A dad holds his sleepy baby close.". Holding a baby close is cuddling.

cuddle.q: Which would be the best thing to cuddle?
cuddle.hint: The answer is "a sleepy kitten". A soft, sleepy kitten is safe to hold close.

cuddle.q: Fill in the blank: 'My little sister likes to ____ her stuffed bunny at night.'
cuddle.hint: The answer is "cuddle". She hugs her bunny close, so cuddle fits.

cuddle.q: Which sentence uses CUDDLE correctly?
options: We will cuddle the soccer ball into the goal.
The puppies cuddle together in their warm bed.
Dad will cuddle the eggs into the hot pan.
cuddle.hint: The answer is "The puppies cuddle together in their warm bed.". Puppies hold close together to stay warm.

cuddle.q: Which word fits: The baby panda wanted to ____ with its mom to stay warm.
cuddle.hint: The answer is "cuddle". Staying warm by snuggling close is cuddling.

cuddle.q: Fill in the blank: 'After the scary movie, Leo wanted to ____ up next to his mom.'
cuddle.hint: The answer is "cuddle". Leo wanted to snuggle close to his mom.

cuddle.q: Which word fits: Grandma opened her arms and said, 'Come here so I can ____ you!'
cuddle.hint: The answer is "cuddle". Open arms mean Grandma wants to hug you close.

cuddle.q: Which is the correct spelling?
cuddle.hint: The answer is "cuddle". Cuddle has double d and ends with -le.

cuddle.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'I love to ____ my cat.'
cuddle.hint: The answer is "cuddle". Cuddle starts with c and ends with -le.

cuddle.q: Fill the missing letters: c_dd_e
cuddle.hint: The answer is "u, l". Put in u and l to spell c-u-d-d-l-e.

cuddle.q: Which of these words is spelled correctly?
cuddle.hint: The answer is "cuddle". Cuddle ends with -le, like puddle.

puffy.q: What part of speech is PUFFY in: 'The sky was full of puffy white clouds.'?
puffy.hint: The answer is "adjective". Puffy describes the clouds.

puffy.q: An adjective describes a noun. Which kind of word is PUFFY?
puffy.hint: The answer is "adjective". Puffy tells what something looks like, so it is an adjective.

puffy.q: Which word is an adjective: puffy, tractor, cuddle?

puffy.q: In 'Jen wore a puffy jacket in the snow,' which noun does PUFFY describe?

puffy.q: Which word in this sentence is an adjective: 'My eyes were puffy after I cried.'?
puffy.hint: The answer is "puffy". Puffy describes how the eyes looked.

puffy.q: What does PUFFY mean?
puffy.hint: The answer is "swollen or puffed up". Something puffy is swollen or puffed up.

puffy.q: Read: 'After the bee sting, Tom's hand was red and puffy.' What happened to Tom's hand?
puffy.hint: The answer is "It swelled up.". Puffy means swollen, so the hand swelled up.

puffy.q: Which word means almost the same as PUFFY?

puffy.q: Which word is the opposite of PUFFY?

puffy.q: Which of these is most likely puffy?
puffy.hint: The answer is "a marshmallow". A marshmallow is soft and puffed up.

puffy.q: What might make your eyes puffy?
puffy.hint: The answer is "crying a lot". Crying can make your eyes swell up.

puffy.q: Fill in the blank: 'The pillows on the couch were soft and ____.'
puffy.hint: The answer is "puffy". Soft pillows are full and puffed up.

puffy.q: Which sentence uses PUFFY correctly?
options: My winter coat is warm and puffy.
She will puffy the ball to me.
The puffy ran across the yard.
puffy.hint: The answer is "My winter coat is warm and puffy.". A puffed-up winter coat is puffy.

puffy.q: Which word fits: After the long nap, Grandpa's eyes looked a little ____.
puffy.hint: The answer is "puffy". Eyes can look swollen after sleeping.

puffy.q: Fill in the blank: 'The baker pulled ____ golden rolls out of the oven.'
puffy.hint: The answer is "puffy". Fresh rolls puff up in the oven.

puffy.q: Which word fits: The bird fluffed its feathers until it looked round and ____.
puffy.hint: The answer is "puffy". Fluffed-up feathers make a bird look puffed up.

puffy.q: Which is the correct spelling?
puffy.hint: The answer is "puffy". Puffy has double f and ends with y.

puffy.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'My jacket is ____.'
puffy.hint: The answer is "puffy". Puffy ends with the letter y.

puffy.q: Fill the missing letters: p_ff_
puffy.hint: The answer is "u, y". Put in u and y to spell p-u-f-f-y.

puffy.q: Which of these words is spelled correctly?
puffy.hint: The answer is "puffy". Puffy is puff with a y at the end.

tiptoed.q: What part of speech is TIPTOED in: 'She tiptoed past the sleeping baby.'?
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "verb". Tiptoed is what she did, so it is an action word.

tiptoed.q: Which word in this sentence is a verb: 'Max tiptoed down the dark hall.'?
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "tiptoed". Tiptoed tells what Max did.

tiptoed.q: Which word is a verb: tiptoed, basement, clever?
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "tiptoed". Tiptoed is an action; basement is a place and clever describes.

tiptoed.q: A verb tells an action. Which kind of word is TIPTOED in: 'The cat tiptoed across the table.'?
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "verb". Tiptoed tells what the cat did.

tiptoed.q: In 'We tiptoed into the kitchen for a snack,' what does TIPTOED tell you?
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "what we did". A verb tells what someone did, like tiptoed.

tiptoed.q: What does TIPTOED mean?
options: walked quietly on the tips of your toes
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "walked quietly on the tips of your toes". Tiptoed means walked softly on your toes.

tiptoed.q: Read: 'Dad tiptoed into my room so he wouldn't wake me.' How did Dad walk?
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "very quietly on his toes". Dad walked softly on his toes to keep things quiet.

tiptoed.q: Which is the opposite of TIPTOED?
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "stomped". Stomping is loud and heavy, the opposite of tiptoeing.

tiptoed.q: Which word means almost the same as TIPTOED?
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "crept". Crept means moved slowly and quietly, like tiptoed.

tiptoed.q: Which of these is an example of someone who tiptoed?
options: Ana sang at the top of her voice.
Ana walked softly so the baby would keep sleeping.
Ana raced loudly down the stairs.
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "Ana walked softly so the baby would keep sleeping.". Walking softly to stay quiet is tiptoeing.

tiptoed.q: When would someone most likely have tiptoed?
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "sneaking past a sleeping dog". You tiptoe when you do not want to wake someone.

tiptoed.q: Fill in the blank: 'Lily ____ down the stairs so no one would hear her.'
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "tiptoed". Lily walked quietly, so tiptoed fits.

tiptoed.q: Which sentence uses TIPTOED correctly?
options: Sam tiptoed his lunch in one big bite.
The tiptoed was wet from the rain.
Sam tiptoed out of the room while his sister napped.
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "Sam tiptoed out of the room while his sister napped.". Sam walked quietly so his sister could nap.

tiptoed.q: Which word fits: The kids ____ to the door to surprise Mom with a cake.
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "tiptoed". To surprise Mom, the kids walked quietly.

tiptoed.q: Fill in the blank: 'The mouse ____ past the sleeping cat.'
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "tiptoed". The mouse moved quietly so the cat would not wake.

tiptoed.q: Which word fits: The ballet dancer ____ gracefully across the stage.
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "tiptoed". Ballet dancers move on the tips of their toes.

tiptoed.q: Which is the correct spelling?

tiptoed.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'Jon ____ into the room.'
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "tiptoed". Tiptoed has one p in the middle and ends with -oed.

tiptoed.q: Fill the missing letters: t_pto_d
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "i, e". Put in i and e to spell t-i-p-t-o-e-d.

tiptoed.q: Which of these words is spelled correctly?
tiptoed.hint: The answer is "tiptoed". Tiptoed is made of tip and toe, plus -d.

clever.q: What part of speech is CLEVER in: 'The clever fox found a way over the fence.'?
clever.hint: The answer is "adjective". Clever describes the fox.

clever.q: An adjective describes a person, place, or thing. Which kind of word is CLEVER?
clever.hint: The answer is "adjective". Clever describes someone, so it is an adjective.

clever.q: Which word is an adjective: clever, basement, tiptoed?

clever.q: In 'Rosa had a clever idea for the science fair,' which noun does CLEVER describe?

clever.q: Which word in this sentence is an adjective: 'Our clever dog opened the gate.'?

clever.q: Which word means almost the same as CLEVER?

clever.q: Which word is the opposite of CLEVER?

clever.q: Which of these would most likely be called clever?
options: a rock sitting in the yard
a crow that uses a stick to get food

clever.q: Fill in the blank: 'The ____ student found a faster way to solve the math problem.'

clever.q: Which sentence uses CLEVER correctly?

clever.q: Which word fits: The parrot was so ____ that it learned ten new words in a week.

clever.q: Fill in the blank: 'That was a ____ trick! How did you do it?'

clever.q: Which word fits: Kai built a ____ robot out of boxes that could pick up toys.

basement.hint: The answer is "noun". Basement names a place in the house.

basement.q: A noun names a person, place, or thing. Which kind of word is BASEMENT?
basement.hint: The answer is "noun". Basement names a place.

basement.q: Which word is a noun: basement, clever, carefully?

basement.q: Which word in this sentence is a noun: 'The dark basement felt cold.'?

basement.q: Is BASEMENT a singular noun or a plural noun?

a small garden behind a school

basement.q: Read: 'When the storm came, we went down to the basement to stay safe.' Where did they go?

basement.q: Which of these would you most likely find in a basement?

basement.q: Which room is the opposite of the basement because it is at the very top of the house?

basement.q: Fill in the blank: 'Dad carried the boxes down the stairs to the ____.'

wetlands.q: Is WETLANDS a singular noun or a plural noun?

wetlands.q: What part of speech is WETLANDS in: 'Frogs and ducks live in the wetlands.'?

wetlands.q: Which word is a plural noun: wetlands, basement, clever?

wetlands.q: Which word in this sentence is a plural noun: 'Tall grass grows in the muddy wetlands.'?

wetlands.q: Read: 'Our class visited the wetlands, and our boots sank into the mud.' What are wetlands?
options: land with very wet, muddy soil
wetlands.hint: The answer is "land with very wet, muddy soil". Boots sinking in mud shows the ground is very wet.

wetlands.q: Which of these is an example of wetlands?

wetlands.q: Which animal would you most likely find in the wetlands?

wetlands.q: Which place is the most opposite of wetlands?

wetlands.q: What would you most likely wear to explore the wetlands?
wetlands.hint: The answer is "tall rubber boots". Rubber boots keep your feet dry in wet, muddy ground.

wetlands.q: Fill in the blank: 'Herons wade through the shallow water of the ____.'
wetlands.hint: The answer is "wetlands". Herons are birds that wade in wet, marshy places.

wetlands.q: Which sentence uses WETLANDS correctly?
options: Dad put the wetlands in the toaster.
I wore my wetlands to keep my feet warm.
Many birds build nests in the wetlands near the river.
wetlands.hint: The answer is "Many birds build nests in the wetlands near the river.". Wetlands are wet places where many birds live.

wetlands.q: Which word fits: Alligators and turtles live in the swampy ____.
wetlands.hint: The answer is "wetlands". Swampy places are wetlands.

wetlands.q: Fill in the blank: 'The muddy ____ help soak up water during big storms.'
wetlands.hint: The answer is "wetlands". Wetlands are muddy land that soaks up water.

wetlands.q: Which word fits: Our class counted ducks at the marshy ____ by the lake.
wetlands.hint: The answer is "wetlands". Marshy land by a lake is wetlands.

wetlands.q: Which is the correct spelling?
wetlands.hint: The answer is "wetlands". Wetlands is wet plus lands, with one t.

wetlands.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'Ducks swim in the ____.'
wetlands.hint: The answer is "wetlands". Wetlands is made of wet and lands.

wetlands.q: Fill the missing letters: w_tl_nds
wetlands.hint: The answer is "e, a". Put in e and a to spell w-e-t-l-a-n-d-s.

wetlands.q: Which of these words is spelled correctly?
wetlands.hint: The answer is "wetlands". Wetlands ends with -lands and an s.

invite.q: What part of speech is INVITE in: 'I will invite my whole class to my party.'?
invite.hint: The answer is "verb". Invite is the action I will do.

invite.q: Which sentence uses INVITE as a verb?
options: Her invite had a picture of a cake on it.
I got an invite to the party.
invite.hint: The answer is "Let's invite Grandma to dinner.". In that sentence, invite is something we do.

invite.q: Which word is a verb: invite, butterflies, clever?
invite.hint: The answer is "invite". Invite is an action; butterflies are things and clever describes.

invite.q: A verb is an action word. Which kind of word is INVITE in: 'Can we invite the new girl to play tag?'
invite.hint: The answer is "verb". Invite is the action of asking someone to come.

invite.q: Which word in this sentence is a verb: 'Please invite your cousins to the picnic.'?
invite.hint: The answer is "invite". Invite tells what to do.

invite.q: What does INVITE mean?
options: to tell someone to go away
to ask someone to come or to join in
invite.hint: The answer is "to ask someone to come or to join in". When you invite someone, you ask them to come.

invite.q: Read: 'Sam wanted to invite Jake to his sleepover.' What did Sam want to do?
invite.hint: The answer is "ask Jake to come". To invite means to ask someone to come.

invite.q: Which word means almost the same as INVITE?
invite.hint: The answer is "ask". When you invite someone, you ask them to come.

invite.q: Which is the opposite of inviting someone to play?
invite.hint: The answer is "leaving them out". Leaving someone out is the opposite of inviting them.

invite.q: Which of these is an example of inviting someone?
options: 'Do you want to sit with us at lunch?'
invite.hint: The answer is "'Do you want to sit with us at lunch?'". Asking someone to sit with you invites them to join.

invite.q: What would you use to invite friends to a birthday party?
options: a card that tells the time and place
invite.hint: The answer is "a card that tells the time and place". A party card asks friends to come.

invite.q: Fill in the blank: 'Mom said I could ____ two friends to the zoo.'
invite.hint: The answer is "invite". You invite friends to come with you.

invite.q: Which sentence uses INVITE correctly?
options: The invite swam in the pond.
Please invite your teeth before bed.
We should invite the new boy to play soccer with us.
invite.hint: The answer is "We should invite the new boy to play soccer with us.". Asking the new boy to play is inviting him.

invite.q: Which word fits: Ella was lonely at recess, so Ty decided to ____ her to join the game.
invite.hint: The answer is "invite". Ty asked Ella to join, so he invited her.

invite.q: Fill in the blank: 'Did you ____ your neighbors to the bake sale?'
invite.hint: The answer is "invite". You ask neighbors to come, so invite fits.

invite.q: Which word fits: The team wanted to ____ the coach to their pizza party.
invite.hint: The answer is "invite". The team wanted to ask the coach to come.

invite.q: Which is the correct spelling?
invite.hint: The answer is "invite". Invite starts with in- and ends with -ite.

invite.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'I will ____ you to my party.'
invite.hint: The answer is "invite". Invite ends with a silent e.

invite.q: Fill the missing letters: inv_t_
invite.hint: The answer is "i, e". Put in i and e to spell i-n-v-i-t-e.

invite.q: Which of these words is spelled correctly?
invite.hint: The answer is "invite". Invite has one n and one t.

butterflies.q: Is BUTTERFLIES a singular noun or a plural noun?
butterflies.hint: The answer is "plural noun". Butterflies means more than one butterfly.

butterflies.q: What part of speech is BUTTERFLIES in: 'Orange butterflies landed on the flowers.'?
butterflies.hint: The answer is "plural noun". Butterflies names more than one insect.

butterflies.q: Which word is a plural noun: butterflies, cuddle, puffy?
butterflies.hint: The answer is "butterflies". Butterflies names more than one thing; cuddle is an action and puffy describes.

butterflies.q: Which word in this sentence is a plural noun: 'Bright butterflies fluttered in the garden.'?
butterflies.hint: The answer is "butterflies". Butterflies names more than one insect.

butterflies.q: In 'The butterflies drank from the flowers,' what does BUTTERFLIES name?
butterflies.hint: The answer is "more than one insect". A plural noun names more than one thing.

butterflies.q: What does BUTTERFLIES mean?
options: thin insects with large, colorful wings
butterflies.hint: The answer is "thin insects with large, colorful wings". Butterflies are insects with big, colorful wings.

butterflies.q: Read: 'We watched butterflies flutter over the garden.' What did they watch?
butterflies.hint: The answer is "insects with colorful wings". Butterflies are insects with colorful wings.

butterflies.q: Which of these is a kind of butterfly?
butterflies.hint: The answer is "a monarch". A monarch is an orange and black butterfly.

butterflies.q: Where would you most likely find butterflies?
options: at the bottom of the ocean
butterflies.hint: The answer is "in a flower garden". Butterflies visit flowers to drink nectar.

butterflies.q: What do butterflies use their large wings for?
options: to fly from flower to flower
to dig holes in the dirt
butterflies.hint: The answer is "to fly from flower to flower". Butterflies flap their wings to fly.

butterflies.q: What do butterflies start out as?
butterflies.hint: The answer is "caterpillars". A caterpillar changes into a butterfly.

butterflies.q: Fill in the blank: 'The garden was full of colorful ____ drinking from the flowers.'
butterflies.hint: The answer is "butterflies". Butterflies drink from flowers.

butterflies.q: Which sentence uses BUTTERFLIES correctly?
options: Two yellow butterflies landed on my sleeve.
I zipped up my butterflies before going out in the snow.
We poured butterflies on our cereal.
butterflies.hint: The answer is "Two yellow butterflies landed on my sleeve.". Butterflies are insects that can land on you.

butterflies.q: Which word fits: The caterpillars turned into beautiful ____.
butterflies.hint: The answer is "butterflies". Caterpillars grow up to be butterflies.

butterflies.q: Fill in the blank: 'In science class, we watched the ____ flap their colorful wings.'
butterflies.hint: The answer is "butterflies". Butterflies have colorful wings.

butterflies.q: Which word fits: At the zoo, a room full of ____ had wings of every color.
butterflies.hint: The answer is "butterflies". Butterflies have wings of many colors.

butterflies.q: Which is the correct spelling?
butterflies.hint: The answer is "butterflies". Change the y in butterfly to i and add -es.

butterflies.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'I saw three ____.'
butterflies.hint: The answer is "butterflies". Butterflies ends with -ies.

butterflies.q: Fill the missing letters: butt_rfl_es
butterflies.hint: The answer is "e, i". Put in e and i to spell b-u-t-t-e-r-f-l-i-e-s.

butterflies.q: Which of these words is spelled correctly?
butterflies.hint: The answer is "butterflies". Butterflies is butter plus flies.
